note: raw reports of the two runs, unmodified; docs/model-eval/cuda.json corpora.ami is copied from these rows

runs.command: model_eval --backend cuda --corpus ami --decoding greedy --decoding beam --model parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 --model parakeet-tdt-110m --model base.en --model parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v3 --model large-v3-turbo

report.pieces: PieceConfig { threshold: 0.5, min_speech: 250ms, min_silence: 2s, speech_pad: 400ms, max_piece: 30s, merge_gap: 1s, context_gap: 10s, prompt_chars: 200, compression_ratio_threshold: 2.4 }

ami.set: AMI IS1009a + ES2004a, IHM with oracle segmentation (the accept m2 rule, asr_eval/refs.rs AmiHeadset): each annotated segment of a speaker, clipped to the UEM, decoded by one call on the speaker's headset and aligned against the speaker's words starting inside it; words outside every segment count as deletions; references: AMI manual annotations v1.6.2.
